coreBelief: PLTR compounds to $250+ by mid-2028 as US commercial AIP revenue — now at $764M/quarter and growing 149% YoY — sustains triple-digit growth for at least 2-3 more quarters, forcing a re-rating from growth optionality to proven FCF compounder at an FCF yield that justifies a structural position.

snapshot.text: $PLTR re-triggered the standing buy above $192.75 and, unlike the earlier false fire, the level is still holding in the live market. Price is around $193.79 with the stock in a confirmed uptrend above rising 20-, 50-, 150-, and 200-day averages, strong relative strength versus SPY, and no fresh contradicting company-specific headline. I proposed a full compounder entry because this seat buys on confirmation when the thesis is intact, not only on pullbacks.

bullets.text: **US commercial compounding is structural, not cyclical:** US commercial RDV of $6.238B, up 124% YoY means the forward revenue pipeline is growing faster than revenue — the business is building backlog, not depleting it. At the current conversion rate, US commercial alone could approach $3B+ annualized by FY2027.

**Government + commercial dual acceleration unprecedented:** US government revenue grew 90% YoY to $809M while US commercial grew 149% YoY to $764M simultaneously — two independent demand channels firing at once, which dramatically lowers the risk that any single vertical slowdown derails the thesis.

**FCF compounding at scale:** FY2025 FCF was $2.10B on $4.48B revenue — a 47% FCF margin. [STRUCTURED:Financials] At 82% guided revenue growth, FY2026 FCF could approach $3.5–4B, implying the stock trades at ~115x FY2026 FCF — still premium, but compressing rapidly if growth sustains.

**Zero debt, massive cash generation:** D/E of 0.00 and current ratio of 7.23 mean Palantir self-funds its growth with no dilution risk from debt service. [STRUCTURED:Financials] Every dollar of FCF goes to compounding the platform, not servicing leverage.

**Dominant relative strength:** PLTR ranks first among its peers in revenue growth (+78.9% YoY vs. APP's +60.6%), YTD performance, and composite score, suggesting institutional conviction in the name is rising, not rotating away.

**Valuation at 284x P/E prices in a decade of perfection:** Even discounting to FY2027 EPS estimates, the stock remains priced for flawless execution. A single guidance miss — not even a miss, just a guidance cut — would reprice the stock 20-30% instantly. [STRUCTURED:P/E 284.8]

**US commercial growth rate must maintain triple digits to justify price:** The existing thesis and the current multiple both assume US commercial sustains 100%+ growth. The math of large numbers makes this harder with each passing quarter: Q2's $764M US commercial base makes 149% growth in Q3 2026 nearly impossible to repeat. Deceleration is inevitable; the question is the pace.

**No open-market insider buying:** [STRUCTURED:Insider Activity] No Form 4 purchase transactions in the last 90 days. At $192/share, insiders are not adding — they may be selling into strength. A 284x P/E without insider accumulation is a sentiment flag.

**Michael Burry and high-profile short interest:** Recent headlines flag Michael Burry's significant short positions in AI stocks, suggesting sophisticated macro investors see valuation excess as a near-term risk in AI-exposed names. PLTR's 1.66 beta amplifies any broad AI de-rating.

**Peer multiple compression risk:** CRM trades at 26x P/E, ADBE at 13x P/E despite comparable or superior business quality on some metrics. [STRUCTURED:Peer Comparison] If the market re-rates AI platform companies toward fundamental value rather than growth optionality, PLTR's 284x multiple has the longest distance to travel.

keyAssumptions: US commercial AIP revenue growth sustains at or above 80% YoY for at least 4 more quarters, supported by the $6.238B RDV pipeline growing 124% YoY
GAAP operating margins hold at or above 40% as revenue scales, confirming that margin expansion is structural and not dependent on one-time items
No major regulatory action or government contract concentration risk event — PLTR's DoD/intelligence relationships remain intact and deepen
invalidationConds: US commercial revenue growth decelerates below 60% YoY for two consecutive quarters — indicating AIP adoption has plateaued rather than broadened
GAAP operating margin falls below 35% on a trailing basis — signaling that the cost structure is scaling faster than revenue and the FCF compounder thesis is broken
Two consecutive quarters of guidance cuts (not just misses — active downward revisions to revenue or margin guidance), signaling management has lost visibility
A major US government contract cancellation or debarment event that removes more than 20% of government revenue — the structural government franchise underpins the dual-channel demand thesis

variantView: Consensus treats PLTR as a momentum/AI-hype trade; I think the US commercial compounding rate — with $6.2B RDV growing 124% YoY — is a durable FCF machine that will look cheap at current prices in 24 months, falsifiable if US commercial growth decelerates below 60% YoY for two consecutive quarters.

lines: Entry: Whichever comes first: a base breakout, a reclaim of the 50-day, or a pullback that holds the 50-day. A stock at new highs on a working thesis is working, not extended; with no pullback in 30 days of uptrend, take the breakout. When one is already true, set the entry at the current price. Confirm a buy by: Thesis intact; volume matters less than for a trade
Stop: Thesis invalidation named in advance (guidance cut twice, margin break, capital-allocation failure). A close below the 200-day and a 15% give-back are reviews.
Target: A 3–5 year valuation case; trims only at valuation extremes.
Time: A 60-day business checkpoint (is what we said would happen starting to happen?) — a review, never a time stop.
Failure looks like: The named invalidation happens; Guidance cut; Margin break
